verdict.rationale: A visual level editor is a fair axis for a game engine, so the story applies. The evidence describes an agent-driven workflow: describing games, MCP/CLI tooling, publishing, and native C++/C# code. Nothing documents a viewport, inspector, prefab or scene-composition editor as the primary level-building method; the 'full engine' claim covers runtime features (2D/3D, physics, animation), not visual editor tooling.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels
